conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Some common techniques include machine learning algorithms like supervised learning, unsupervised learning, and reinforcement learning. These approaches help machines process data and improve their performance on specific tasks.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
